sources.title: Devseis/endpoint-auditor-0.5b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A small language model fine-tuned by Devseis to write endpoint audit findings for ISO 27001, GDPR and the EU AI Act from collected evidence. It runs on the device (WebLLM in the Devseis Endpoint Auditor desktop app and phone check), so audit evidence never leaves the computer or phone.

sources.snippet: OpenAI is scrapping the planned release of its next-generation AI model after researchers raised safety concerns during internal testing, Newsweek has confirmed. An OpenAI spokesperson told Newsweek Monday evening that safety leaders made the decision not to ship GPT-6.1 Astra, which was set for an October debut.
